title: Forests for Differences: Beyond Parametric Difference-in-Differences
abstract: arXiv:2505.09706v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper introduces the Difference-in-Differences Bayesian Causal Forest (DiD-BCF), a novel non-parametric model addressing key challenges in DiD estimation, such as staggered adoption and heterogeneous treatment effects. DiD-BCF provides a unified framework for estimating Average (ATE), Group-Average (GATE), and Conditional Average Treatment Effects (CATE). By structuring separate regression forests for cohort-specific levels, common untreated trends and treatment effects, the model directly embeds conditional parallel trends and no-anticipation restrictions into Bayesian nonparametrics. We establish non-parametric identification and integrated treatment effect consistency of the exact treatment effect posterior distribution. Extensive simulations demonstrate DiD-BCF's superior performance over established benchmarks, particularly under non-linearity, selection biases, and effect heterogeneity. translated_title: 森林用于差异：超越参数化双重差分方法
translated_abstract: 本文提出了双重差分贝叶斯因果森林（DiD-BCF），这是一种新颖的非参数模型，旨在解决双重差分估计中的关键挑战，例如错峰采用和异质性处理效应。DiD-BCF提供了一个统一框架，用于估计平均处理效应（ATE）、组平均处理效应（GATE）和条件平均处理效应（CATE）。通过为特定队列的水平、共同的未处理趋势和处理效应分别构建回归森林，该模型将条件平行趋势和无预期限制直接嵌入到贝叶斯非参数方法中。我们建立了精确处理效应后验分布的非参数识别性和综合处理效应一致性。大量仿真实验表明，DiD-BCF相比现有基准方法具有更优越的性能，尤其是在存在非线性、选择偏差和效应异质性的情况下。该方法被应用于美国最低工资政策（评估）……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 本文提出双重差分贝叶斯因果森林（DiD-BCF）这一非参数模型，统一估计ATE、GATE和CATE，并将条件平行趋势与无预期假设直接嵌入贝叶斯非参数框架，在非线性、选择偏差和效应异质性场景下显著优于现有基准方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Difference-in-Differences Bayesian Causal Forest (DiD-BCF), a non-parametric model that uniformly estimates ATE, GATE, and CATE while directly embedding conditional parallel trends and no-anticipation restrictions into Bayesian nonparametrics, outperforming existing benchmarks under non-linearity, selection bias, and effect heterogeneity.
